The main takeaway from our work is that
glycogen biosynthesis is a highly regulated process that involves a number of enzymes.

the initiation of glycogenesis is a two-step reaction: (i) formation of an α-1,6-linked glucosyl residue from UDPG by an enzyme that we term UDP-glucose:α-D-glucan 6-α-D-glucosyl transferase; and (ii) transfer of this residue to a growing α-1, 4-linked glucan chain by glycogen synthase.
